info.title: TRIMME API
info.description: Public, customer, shop and admin API for the TRIMME salon and barber booking marketplace.

get.summary: API name, version and current server time (UTC).
A stored image (JPEG, PNG or WebP). Public and immutable: a new upload always gets a new id.
The signed-in user with roles and permissions.
The signed-in shop user's shop, from the session (never from the request).
An active shop's public profile. No professional or customer contact data.
The shop's own professionals, read-only and without contact data.
Active professionals of an active shop. No contact data.
Issues the CSRF cookie and returns its value for the X-CSRF-Token header.

post.summary: Sends a 6-digit sign-in code to a Saudi mobile number (customers).
Verifies the code, signs the customer in (creating the account if new) and sets the session cookies.
Saves a new customer's name, language and terms acceptance.
Shop and admin staff sign in with email and password.
Emails a password-reset link to a staff account. Always returns 202.
Sets a new staff password from an emailed link and signs out every device.
Creates a staff account from an emailed invitation and signs it in.
Rotates the refresh cookie and re-issues the access cookie.
Ends the current session and clears the session cookies.

get.summary: The signed-in user's active sessions (devices).

delete.summary: Signs out one of the user's own sessions.

post.summary: Signs out every other device; the current session stays signed in.

get.summary: The permission catalogue.
Roles with their granted permissions.

post.summary: Emails a platform-admin invitation for the given admin role.
Emails a ShopOwner or ShopStaff invitation for one shop (audited).
Creates a shop in Draft status.

get.summary: Shops, newest first, with search (name, slug, district) and status filter (paged).
One shop with its profile, location and shop-edit policy.

put.summary: Edits the public profile and verification (audited, optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Activates a draft or suspended shop (audited).
Suspends a shop; its users lose access to shop data immediately (audited).

put.summary: Sets the confirmed map point and address (audited).
Sets which profile fields the shop may edit itself (audited).
Replaces the logo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB; audited).
Replaces the cover image (1600×900 recommended; audited).

post.summary: Adds a gallery image (up to 12; audited).

get.summary: The shop's own profile and the admin's edit policy. Not available while suspended.

put.summary: Edits the fields the admin policy opens to the shop; a locked field that changes answers 403.
Replaces the logo, if the policy allows.

delete.summary: Removes the logo, if the policy allows.

put.summary: Replaces the cover image, if the policy allows.

delete.summary: Removes the cover image, if the policy allows.

post.summary: Adds a gallery image, if the policy allows.

delete.summary: Removes one of the shop's gallery images, if the policy allows.

put.summary: Sets the shop's map point, if the admin policy opens the location to the shop.

get.summary: Address and district search for the location picker (server-side provider, cached).
The address at a map point, for the picker's confirmation card.
Address and district search for the location picker (server-side provider, cached).
The address at a map point, for the picker's confirmation card.

post.summary: Creates a professional in exactly one shop (audited).

get.summary: Professionals with shop, status and search filters (paged). Numbers are masked.
One professional. The WhatsApp number is masked.

put.summary: Edits the profile (audited, optimistic concurrency). The shop cannot change.

post.summary: Hides the professional from booking (audited).
Makes a disabled professional active again (audited).

put.summary: Sets or corrects the WhatsApp number and the notification toggle (audited, number never logged).

post.summary: Returns the full number once, for a stated reason (audited; never cached).

put.summary: Replaces the photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB; audited).

AdminProfessionalListItem.description: A professional in the admin list.

AdminProfessionalResponse.description:
A professional as the platform admin edits it. Guid AdminProfessionalResponse.ShopId is read-only: it is fixed at creation and no
request can change it (R-NEG-01).

AdminShopDetailResponse.description: A shop with its full profile, location and shop-edit policy, as the platform admin edits it.

AdminShopResponse.description: A shop in the admin list.

AdminWhatsAppResponse.description: The WhatsApp settings an admin sees. The number itself is only ever masked here (reveal is a separate, audited action).

CreateProfessionalRequest.description: The one shop is chosen here, at creation, and can never be changed afterwards (D-011).

GeocodedPlace.description: An address search or reverse-geocoding result.

LocationSource.description: How the location point was chosen in the picker.

MeResponse.description:
The signed-in user (`GET /api/v1/me`). `UserType` is `Customer`, `ShopUser` or
`PlatformAdmin`. A customer sees only their own number, masked. `ShopId` is set for shop users from
Phase 05. `ProfileComplete` is false until a customer has given a name and accepted the terms.

OtpChallengeResponse.description: Response to an OTP request. The code is never returned.

PagedResponseOfAdminProfessionalListItem.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfAdminShopResponse.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PublicProfessionalResponse.description: A professional on the public shop page. Never carries a phone or WhatsApp number (R-PRO-02).

PublicShopLocationResponse.description: Where a customer finds the shop: the confirmed point and the address, without who confirmed it.

PublicShopResponse.description:
A published shop's basic profile (`GET /public/shops/{slug}`). Only active shops are published. The phone is the
shop's own business number; professional and customer numbers are never part of a public contract (R-PRO-02).

RevealedWhatsAppResponse.description: The full number, returned once per audited reveal. Never cached.

SetProfessionalWhatsAppRequest.description:
Sets, corrects or removes (null) the WhatsApp number (E.164 or a Saudi national format), and the notification
toggle. With `KeepCurrentNumber` only the toggle changes, so an admin never needs to see the number to do that.

ShopCategory.description: Kind of business, shown on the public page and used by discovery filters (Phase 11).

ShopLocationResponse.description: The confirmed shop entrance. Coordinates are WGS 84 decimal degrees.

ShopProfessionalResponse.description:
A professional as the shop sees it (read-only: the shop cannot create, edit or move professionals, spec §7).
Shop-facing contract: no contact data of any kind.

ShopProfileField.description: Profile areas an admin can open to or lock from the shop (DV-S16). Verification and slug are never shop-editable.

ShopProfileResponse.description:
The signed-in shop user's own shop (`GET /api/v1/shop/me`). Shop-facing contract: it must never carry customer
contact data (R-NEG-04). The status is reported even while suspended, so the dashboard can explain it.

SignInResponse.description:
Result of a successful sign-in; the session cookies are set on the response. `IsNewUser` is true when the OTP
verification (or an invitation) created the account.

UpdateOwnShopProfileRequest.description: The shop's own edit. Send the whole form: fields locked by the admin policy must keep their current value.

UpdateProfessionalRequest.description: Profile edit. There is deliberately no shop field: a professional cannot be moved to another shop.

UpdateShopProfileRequest.description:
The admin's profile edit. `Version` is the value the client read; a stale value answers 409
`resource.concurrency_conflict`.

WhatsAppVerification.description: Delivery state of the WhatsApp number, set by the notification worker (Phase 15).
